newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end softer, next target seen 1,500.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end softer, next target seen 1,500.

text.p: Austria's ATX index ended the week lower after stronger-than-expected U.S. nonfarm payrolls and a decline in the U.S. unemployment rate but traders saw a pick-up next week, with 1,500 in sight.
The blue chip ATX dropped 9.03 points, or 0.09 percent, to 1,471.46. Among its constituents were 13 losers and seven gainers, while one share was unchanged.
Traders said a lower-than-expected U.S. jobless rate in July brought mild pressure on shares but noted that the relatively slight reaction on slim turnover should not prove lasting.
"The basic mood continues to be positive and there's no reason why we should not climb further on Monday," said one trader.
The session's top gainer brewer was Brau Union rising 1.56 percent to 847 schillings.
High-grade steelmaker Boehler led the decliners, down 2.85 percent at 1,020 schillings.
The August ATX future tumbled 11.6 points to 1,470.0.
